title: GPT-6 Cyber is for approved defenders. It is not in ChatGPT
friendlyTitle: GPT-6 Cyber is for approved security teams. It is not in ChatGPT
summary: On 5 November, OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model for finding and validating vulnerabilities inside a scope a researcher sets. It is initially available through the API and Codex to a select group of approved Daybreak Red customers, not in ordinary ChatGPT. OpenAI says it will expand to all Daybreak Red customers soon, and that GPT-5.6 Cyber is now available to every Daybreak Red customer. On ExploitGym, which tests whether a model can exploit a specified vulnerability, GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5%, up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber. OpenAI classifies it as Critical in cybersecurity under its Preparedness Framework, up from High for GPT-5.6 Cyber. On a honeypot test of staying inside the assigned task, OpenAI says it avoided out-of-scope services in 99.93% of runs without a deployment prompt, and in 100% with that prompt. OpenAI also says the model produced evidence for 81 previously unknown Firefox vulnerabilities that Mozilla classified as high severity, and that Mozilla began landing fixes after the reports.
friendlySummary: On 5 November, OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber. It is a model trained to find security holes and check that they are real, inside the job a researcher sets. At first it is available through the API and Codex only to a small group of approved Daybreak Red customers. It is not in ordinary ChatGPT. OpenAI says it will open it to all Daybreak Red customers soon, and that the older GPT-5.6 Cyber is now available to every Daybreak Red customer. On a test called ExploitGym, which asks whether a model can use a named hole, GPT-6 Cyber scores 48.5%. The older cyber model scored 32.1%. OpenAI now rates this model Critical for cybersecurity, up from High for the previous one. On a separate test of staying inside the assigned job, OpenAI says it avoided unrelated systems in 99.93% of runs without an extra safety prompt, and in 100% with that prompt. OpenAI also says the model found evidence for 81 Firefox holes Mozilla had not known about and classed as high severity, and that Mozilla started shipping fixes after the reports.
whyItMatters: If you are not on Daybreak Red, this is not a setting you can turn on. Mainline models such as GPT-6 Astra already do code review and patch drafting. GPT-6 Cyber is the deeper model, and OpenAI is keeping it on an approved list. A lab score is not a promise that it will find the bug in your repository, and a vendor quote is not an independent test.
